title: Fully-autonomous perception navigation solver (auto branch_mode) + scored-path proof via PerceptionNavigationPolicy through run_game.
not_a_new_solve_claim: tu93 L3 is already registered; this validates the FULLY autonomous solver (auto branch_mode, no per-game input) + that the scored run_game interface carries it. No registry change.
plan_then_replay_caveat: The solve runs in the policy __init__ (offline arcade verifier-routed search), then replays the discovered path via the scored run_game interface (is_done/next_move) -- the same plan-then-replay shape CarnotAgentPolicy uses, but the plan is SELF-DISCOVERED from perception, not hand-banked. 'search live on the scored env during play' (consuming budget) is the remaining architectural step; here the search runs on the offline arcade, same as the dev-twin.
headline: SCORED-PATH INTEGRATION COMPLETE: the fully-autonomous perception navigation solver (perception derives (player=9,goal=14) from motion; branch_mode SELF-CORRECTS via the reproduction gate; generic search machinery -- ZERO per-game hand-RE) reproduces tu93 L3, AND the scored run_game interface carries it: PerceptionNavigationPolicy reached L3 (levels=3) vs the default explorer's 0. The scored agent self-discovers and reproduces a navigation solve, driven by the real scored interface.
